_note: Icon-in-disc ratio fix. The steps and icons layouts drew their icon at ~47% of the disc diameter, which the operator flagged as the glyph not covering the circle. ICON_IN_DISC is now 0.65, matching the list layout's long-standing 46px/30px circle. These are re-renders of the 17 cards already live in those two layouts; content, titles and alt text are unchanged, only the icon size differs. The -r2 suffix keeps the new file a distinct attachment so the live one is never overwritten.
